faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Rohini Courts, Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Rohini Courts, Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Court Auctioneer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Rohini Courts, Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma enclosed with the notice (page 4)) and send it to R & I Branch, Ground Floor, Room No. 1, Rohini Courts, Delhi, by through proper channel i.e. through r&i branch of the office, to reach by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Not specified.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Member of the Bar with a standing of at least 5 years or more at the Bar and a Gross Professional Income of Rs. 6 Lakhs or more per annum.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a member of the Bar enrolled as an Advocate with the Bar Council of Delhi. Reference of two Advocates of ten years standing or of other respectable persons required.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application forms not complying with the instructions shall be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rohini Courts, Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Filled proforma and Diary No. from the R & I Branch; One recent passport size photograph; Self-attested copies of RCBA I-card, BCD I-card and BCD Enrollment Certificate; Income Affidavit / ITR (copy of last two ITRs or other income document); Reference of two advocates (10 years standing) with mobile number/sign & stamp, and age proof.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notification describes the engagement as: Contract.
